answer_1.quote: an elaboration refers to additional context describing some background knowledge about the question... we model the elaboration generator using a generative language model that computes the distribution of tokens at each generation step.

answer_4.quote: The annotation task was carried out in Amazon Mechanical Turk... we paid workers an estimated US$15 per hour.
answer_4.guideline: we pick three aspects: (1) Factuality evaluates whether the text is entirely correct... (2) Relevance evaluates whether the text is relevant... (3) Helpfulness evaluates whether the text provides useful information...
